```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
I am creating a table of the top 10 rows of the migratory cinnectivity data file
```{r}
migratory_connectivity <- read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migratory_connectivity))
```
I want to find out about the data in my table 
```{r}
glimpse(migratory_connectivity)
```
there are 100 rows and 34 columns 
the data type for the column Tag is character 
the data type for the columb Birth is integer 

```{r}

migratory_connectivity_selected <- migratory_connectivity |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(migratory_connectivity_selected)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
  
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected) 

migratory_connectivity_exc <- migratory_connectivity_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(migratory_connectivity_exc)

bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(bird_breeding_exc)
```
